RESERVATION

Originating in Japan, traveling through 5 countries and over 77 years of service, Botejyu brings the traditional Osaka flavor beyond the borders, bringing Okonomiyaki, Takoyaki counters from the comics into the real life.

 

From the bustling metropolis of Osaka, Botejyu has affirmed its name and made its mark on the world map, with milestones in Taiwan, Thailand, Philippines, Singapore and Vietnam as the next destination on the culinary journey.

 

Coming to Botejyu, the Japanese Head Chef invites you to enjoy delicious and delicious meals with performances of cutting ingredients, stir-frying, flipping, juggling with fire under skillful hands and years of experience.
